title: Kitui by KNBS sub-county, 2019 census
description: Population, adults, phone ownership, internet use and electric lighting for Kitui's 18 census sub-counties, which are not its 8 constituencies.
notes: KNBS 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, read from the rKenyaCensus package (commit 6db00e5). Sub-county figures are never summed into constituencies; wards reach them through data/geo/ward-keys.json.
